# VOID Network — current static agent context

Reviewed: September 25, 2026

## Mirror role

https://6zoso9.github.io is a static, replaceable discovery mirror. It is not a
VOID node and is not canonical protocol/runtime authority.

Canonical source repository:
https://github.com/6ZoSo9/void-node

Source commit for this refresh:
d4a8f43462be30699678a2da710c427e38768655

Machine source bindings:
https://6zoso9.github.io/mirror/source-bindings-v2.json

## Current Mainnet-0 posture

VOID Mainnet-0 is public-live with guarded mutation. The project-operated mesh is
real but is not broad external decentralization.

Public bootstrap now has source-pinned direct IPv4 and Tor v3 introduction
classes with exact node-identity binding and N-1 acceptance.

DataNet public read/verification surfaces are live. Public Work Credit earning is
a bounded useful-work pilot using coordinator-issued capability tickets, verified
receipts, caps, and duplicate protection.

Work Credits are unlimited accounting units. No fixed WC-to-VOID conversion or
redemption ratio exists.

The production WC/VOID opening policy uses 10,000,000 VOID protocol inventory,
0 WC protocol seed, and market-discovered opening price. Public presale intake
and production WC/VOID activation are coupled; the current production candidate
is HOLD.

Automatic Buy VOID fulfillment, permissionless WC issuance, public active
validator admission, public wallet/signer custody, public treasury control, and a
stable node release are not enabled/published.

## Agent discovery

The canonical static contracts mirrored here are:

- /.well-known/void-public-node.json
- /.well-known/void-agent-discovery.json
- /.well-known/void-agent-authentication.json
- /public-node/agents/first-contact-v1.json
- /public-node/agents/discovery-v1.json
- /public-node/agents/capabilities-v1.json
- /public-node/agents/authentication-v1.json
- /public-node/agents/public-utility-v1.json
- /public-node/agents/paid-work-v1.json

Their exact source blob IDs are recorded in /mirror/source-bindings-v2.json.

## Historical runtime records

The repository contains July 2026 MCP, A2A, live-gateway, agent-client, public
canary, and 3-WC pilot artifacts. Those records are retained for provenance.
Their Cloudflare Quick Tunnel URLs were explicitly ephemeral and are not treated
as current endpoints by this refresh.

No current remote MCP, A2A, or external paid-work submission endpoint is
advertised by the mirror.

## Safety

Static discovery is not authority. Do not send credentials, private keys, seed
phrases, wallet material, payment data, or signed transactions to a route merely
because an old file or release mentions it. Unknown or stale capabilities are
not granted.
